properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 (SHA-224/256/384/512 implementations) is resolved in the shipped dependency graph as the hash layer of elliptic@6.5.5/6.5.7 (referenced at pnpm-lock.yaml:19724, :19734, :20955), which reaches the build via the MetaMask SDK chain (eciesjs → secp256k1 → elliptic). Changeable here only by swapping wallet-connector dependencies. No first-party call site found in application code; the packages consume it internally.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped dependency inventory: @stablelib/poly1305@1.0.1 and the Poly1305 MAC inside @stablelib/chacha20poly1305@1.0.1 are resolved and installed, pulled transitively by @walletconnect/utils 2.12/2.13/2.16 (via @web3modal/wagmi → WalletConnect relay session encryption). No first-party call site — presence records what the build ships; use is inside WalletConnect.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: secp256k1 (the EVM signing curve) arrives via eciesjs@0.3.19 → @metamask/sdk-communication-layer@0.28.2 (lockfile:19703-19711), used for ECIES hybrid encryption of the MetaMask SDK communication channel between dapp and wallet. Also the curve behind every EVM wallet signature in this marketplace. Migration would come from the wallet-connector vendors, not this codebase — observable here, replaceable upstream.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge@1.3.1 resolved in the lockfile as a dependency of selfsigned@2.4.1, itself pulled by @react-native/dev-middleware@0.74.85 (transitive chain of the web3 wallet SDKs) — so the RSA implementation ships in the build. No application call site found (no import of node-forge anywhere in app source); presence is what this inventory records. Shor-vulnerable PKE, harvest-now-decrypt-later relevant if used for key transport.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: X25519 key agreement is the encryption core of the WalletConnect relay protocol — dapp↔wallet messages are key-agreed with X25519, then HKDF-derived, then sealed with ChaCha20-Poly1305 (both separately inventoried). WalletConnect is pulled by @web3modal/wagmi/@wagmi connectors (direct deps in package.json). Observable here; the crypto suite is fixed by the WalletConnect protocol, replaceable only upstream.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: @stablelib/ed25519@1.0.3 resolved as dependency of @walletconnect/relay-auth@1.0.4 (via @web3modal/wagmi): Ed25519 signatures authenticate the WalletConnect relay client. Shor-vulnerable signature scheme (harvest/forge-later); no first-party call site — use is inside WalletConnect.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: elliptic is the pure-JS ECDSA/ECDH implementation over secp256k1 (and short Weierstrass curves) backing the native secp256k1 addon inside the MetaMask SDK's eciesjs chain. No first-party call site in application code; consumed by the wallet-connector stack. Changeable only by swapping wallet dependencies.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.5/6.5.7 resolved via @walletconnect/utils@2.16.1 (via @web3modal/wagmi): ships ECDH and ECDSA over secp256k1/secp256r1, consumed inside WalletConnect. Shor-vulnerable key agreement/signature library; no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: two independent HKDF consumers. @stablelib/hkdf derives keys in WalletConnect's relay encryption (X25519 ECDH → HKDF-SHA256 → ChaCha20-Poly1305); futoin-hkdf is the KDF inside eciesjs (secp256k1 ECIES) for the MetaMask SDK channel. All sites are resolution entries; no first-party HKDF call site in app code. Replaceable only upstream in the wallet stacks.
